= callout-guard-subs(1)
:doctype: manpage
:revdate: 2026-10-06
:manmanual: Callout checks
:mansource: acdc
:name: café

== Name
callout-guard-subs - substitutions around callouts

== Synopsis

[[target]]
Target paragraph.

[source,text,subs="+macros,+quotes,+attributes,+replacements"]
----
S01 {name} (C) link:https://example.org[Link] // <1>
S02 *Bold* _Italic_ # <2><3>
S03 ((Indexed)) anchor:code-target[]xref:target[Target] ;; <4>
S04 footnote:note[One note.] <!--5-->
S05 pass:[raw //] <6>
S06 code -- <7>
----
<1> Link, attributes and typography.
<2> Formatting.
<3> Adjacent marker.
<4> Index and cross-reference.
<5> Footnote before XML guard.
<6> Raw prefix stays literal.
<7> Enabled typography follows guard removal.

[subs="+macros,+quotes,+attributes,+replacements"]
....
S07 {name} *Bold* link:https://example.org[Link] // <.>
S08 footnote:note[] <!--2-->
....
<.> Literal substitutions.
<.> Literal note and XML marker.

[literal,subs="+quotes,+macros"]
S09 *Bold* link:https://example.org[Link] // <1>

<1> Literal paragraph substitutions.

[source,xml,subs="-callouts"]
----
S10 <tag/> <!--1--> // <2>
----

[subs="-callouts"]
....
S11 literal // <1>
....

[source,text,subs="specialcharacters"]
----
S12 literal (C) // <1>
----

[source,text,subs="callouts"]
----
S13 plain // <1>
----
<1> Callouts without special-character substitution.

[source,text,subs="+macros"]
----
S14 pass:[// <1>]
----

See <<code-target,Code>>. Reuse footnote:note[].
